name: remi-promo
description: Video promosi Remi Kampung Madya (Remotion). Bukan workspace; tidak ikut build/test aplikasi.

scripts.render:a: remotion render src/index.ts TeaserA out/teaser-a-mentah.mp4 --color-space=bt709 && node scripts/normalkan-audio.mjs out/teaser-a-mentah.mp4 out/teaser-a.mp4
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Teaser out/mentah.mp4 && remotion ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i out/mentah.mp4 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/teaser-reels.mp4
